faq.a: Chrome 85+ (August 2020), Firefox 93+ (October 2021), Safari 16.4+ (March 2023). Edge supports AVIF since it's Chromium. Internet Explorer does not support AVIF.

faq.q: Why should I convert AVIF to JPG?
faq.a: AVIF has limited support on social media platforms (Twitter, Facebook), email clients, and older browsers. Converting to JPG ensures maximum compatibility.
Converting AVIF to JPG at 90-100% quality preserves visual quality well. For lossless conversion, use PNG format. WebP is recommended as a balance between quality and compatibility.

faq.q: Can I encode AVIF in browser?
faq.a: Currently no browser-side JavaScript library can encode AVIF (requires AV1 encoder). This tool focuses on decoding AVIF and converting to other formats. AVIF encoding requires server-side tools like libavif.
